_comment_1: Add the entry under `mcpServers` in your existing claude_desktop_config.json. Restart Claude Desktop after editing.
_comment_2: Config file location on macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
_comment_3: After install + restart, the 5 tools appear in Claude Desktop as: weave-core/view, weave-core/create, weave-core/str_replace, weave-core/insert, weave-core/delete
_setup_notes: 1. `command` — absolute path to the Python interpreter in your sandbox venv. Find it by running:  cd ~/weave-2.0-sandbox && echo $(pwd)/.venv/bin/python
2. `WEAVE_VAULT_PATH` — absolute path to the markdown vault directory you want Claude Desktop to read and write. Can be any subtree containing your notes.
3. Apple's iCloud Drive paths look like:  /Users/<you>/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/<...> — these work fine as vault paths.
4. Restart Claude Desktop fully (Cmd-Q then reopen) after editing this file. MCP servers are loaded at launch.
5. Smoke test: ask Claude something like 'use weave-core/view to list the directory at the vault root'. You should see your vault's top-level entries.
